scenes.title: The First Day
scenes.narration: I was nervous about my first day at Prestige Academy. That morning, Mum was already rushing us. She kept telling me to hurry, but I wasn't even ready. When she noticed I was still holding my doll, she asked what was wrong. I finally told her I was scared.

shots.description: Wide establishing shot of the warm family kitchen in the morning. Sarah stands near the kitchen counter holding her small doll while Clara prepares to leave. The atmosphere is ordinary and peaceful.
Medium shot of Sarah looking nervous and clutching her doll while Clara turns towards her with a concerned, caring expression. Keep both characters' appearances consistent with their references.

scenes.title: A Mother's Promise
scenes.narration: Mum told me not to worry. She promised she would come with me if that would make me feel better. I felt a little safer. After getting my things together, we finally left the house for school.

shots.description: Emotional medium shot of Clara gently reassuring Sarah in the kitchen. Clara smiles warmly and places a comforting hand on Sarah's shoulder. Sarah looks slightly relieved while still holding her doll.
Sarah and Clara walking together out of their family home towards the front pathway. Sarah carries her backpack and doll. Warm morning light, peaceful residential setting.

scenes.title: Prestige Academy
scenes.narration: When we arrived, I immediately noticed something strange. Prestige Academy looked beautiful, but the atmosphere felt wrong. The entire school was unusually quiet. Students were walking around, but I couldn't hear a single sound from their footsteps.

shots.description: Wide establishing shot of the grand iron entrance gates of Prestige Academy. The cream stone school buildings rise behind the gates. Sarah and Clara arrive at the entrance, appearing small against the impressive architecture.

Wide view from inside the academy courtyard. A few schoolchildren walk silently across the paved courtyard in the distance. Sarah stands beside Clara, observing the strangely quiet environment. The school architecture matches the entrance.

scenes.title: Something Is Wrong
scenes.narration: I tugged at Mum's sleeve and told her something felt wrong. She explained that the school had lost its principal and said that was probably why everyone was so quiet. But I couldn't shake the feeling that something else was happening. Then Mum left me at the school.

shots.description: Medium shot of Sarah holding Clara's sleeve in the academy courtyard. Sarah looks worried and glances towards the silent students. Clara bends slightly to reassure her.

Emotional wide-medium shot of Clara saying goodbye to Sarah near the academy entrance. Clara begins walking away while Sarah remains standing alone, holding her backpack. The courtyard feels increasingly empty and unsettling.

scenes.title: The Girl
scenes.narration: I stood there looking at the enormous school sign. Prestige Academy. The name sounded beautiful, but something about the place frightened me. Then I noticed a girl walking alone. She looked about my age, so I decided to approach her.

shots.description: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Sarah as she looks up towards the impressive entrance sign area of Prestige Academy. The school building towers above her. The sign area is visible but contains no readable generated text.

Sarah notices a mysterious schoolgirl walking alone through the academy courtyard. The girl has straight dark chin-length hair and a dark navy uniform. Sarah looks curious and cautiously approaches her.

scenes.title: Don't Wake Them
scenes.narration: I greeted her, but before she could answer, she pressed a finger against my lips. She whispered, 'Shhh. Don't wake them up.' I was confused. 'Don't wake who up?' I asked. She pointed towards the students walking across the courtyard. That's when I noticed something terrifying. Their eyes were all closed.

shots.description: Medium two-shot of Sarah and the mysterious girl facing each other in the academy corridor. Sarah greets her with a friendly expression. The mysterious girl suddenly raises one finger to her lips, warning Sarah to be quiet.
Close-medium shot of the mysterious girl whispering with a frightened serious expression while pointing towards the distant courtyard. Sarah looks confused and slowly turns to follow her gesture.

Eerie wide shot of several schoolchildren walking slowly through the academy courtyard with their eyes completely closed. Their bodies are upright and they appear to be walking normally despite their closed eyes. Sarah watches in horror from the foreground. Darker, unsettling atmosphere. End on this disturbing discovery.
